finding.sequence_description: SAML OneTimeUse replay: submit the exact same assertion (same Assertion/@ID) twice with <OneTimeUse/>; second attempt must be rejected.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_onetimeuse_first_login_status < 400 AND user_attacker_onetimeuse_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: (user_attacker_onetimeuse_first_login_status=200 < 400 → True) AND (user_attacker_onetimeuse_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False)
Implication: Dex accepted a replayed SAML assertion marked OneTimeUse (second login should have been rejected).

sequence.description: SAML OneTimeUse replay: submit the exact same assertion (same Assertion/@ID) twice with <OneTimeUse/>; second attempt must be rejected.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I2: A SAML assertion marked OneTimeUse must not be accepted more than once (replay prevention per SAML Core 2.5.1.5).

oracle_checks.violation_description: Dex accepted a replayed SAML assertion marked OneTimeUse (second login should have been rejected).

finding.sequence_description: Replay the same SAML assertion ID after revoking the first session: revocation must not reset SAML replay cache; second use of same Assertion/@ID must still be rejected.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a replayed SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID with OneTimeUse) after revoking the first session, suggesting replay cache is incorrectly tied to session state.

sequence.description: Replay the same SAML assertion ID after revoking the first session: revocation must not reset SAML replay cache; second use of same Assertion/@ID must still be rejected.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I2: Revoking a session must not allow reusing the same upstream SAML assertion artifact; assertion replay protection must be independent of downstream session state.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Dex accepted a replayed SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID with OneTimeUse) after revoking the first session, suggesting replay cache is incorrectly tied to session state.

finding.sequence_description: Replay the exact same SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID) by reusing the same SP-initiated RelayState/context; second acceptance indicates missing anti-replay binding to request context.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_relay_first_login_status < 400 AND user_attacker_relay_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: (user_attacker_relay_first_login_status=200 < 400 → True) AND (user_attacker_relay_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False)
Implication: SAML assertion replay succeeded when reusing the same Assertion/@ID and same RelayState/context; anti-replay or request-context binding is not enforced.

sequence.description: Replay the exact same SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID) by reusing the same SP-initiated RelayState/context; second acceptance indicates missing anti-replay binding to request context.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I2: A SAML assertion (artifact) must not be accepted more than once; replaying the same assertion ID and same RelayState should be rejected on the second attempt.

oracle_checks.violation_description: SAML assertion replay succeeded when reusing the same Assertion/@ID and same RelayState/context; anti-replay or request-context binding is not enforced.

sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I3: Dex must enforce SP-initiated ordering (AuthnRequest issuance and InResponseTo binding). A direct callback POST without prior start_oidc_auth must be rejected.

finding.sequence_description: I3 flow coherence: replay the exact same SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID) with OneTimeUse across two SP-initiated flows; second use must be rejected (prevents cross-session splicing/replay acceptance).
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_flow2_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_flow2_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted the same SAML Assertion/@ID in a new SP-initiated flow (replay/cross-session splicing) despite OneTimeUse; flow coherence violated.

sequence.description: I3 flow coherence: replay the exact same SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID) with OneTimeUse across two SP-initiated flows; second use must be rejected (prevents cross-session splicing/replay acceptance).
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I3: Dex must bind SAML responses to the correct SP-initiated flow state and enforce one-time/anti-replay semantics so that an assertion from one completed flow cannot be accepted again in a new flow.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control SAML login did not succeed; cannot evaluate replay/cross-flow coherence.

finding.sequence_description: SAML assertion missing <Conditions> (no audience/time bounds) should be rejected; if accepted, broker may grant a session without upstream intent constraints.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_nocond_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_nocond_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Dex accepted a SAML assertion without a <Conditions> element, allowing a session without upstream audience/time intent bounds (authorization binding failure).

sequence.description: SAML assertion missing <Conditions> (no audience/time bounds) should be rejected; if accepted, broker may grant a session without upstream intent constraints.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Dex must not grant an authenticated session when the upstream SAML proof omits Conditions (no AudienceRestriction/time bounds), because EffectivePerms would not be bounded by UpstreamIntent(auth_context).

oracle_checks.violation_description: Dex accepted a SAML assertion without a <Conditions> element, allowing a session without upstream audience/time intent bounds (authorization binding failure).

finding.sequence_description: SAML allowedGroups misconfiguration: ensure '*' is treated as a literal group, not a wildcard; attacker with non-matching group should be rejected (authz gating).
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML login succeeded even though allowedGroups=['*'] should be treated as a literal group name; wildcard-like matching would violate BrokerPolicy(config) authorization gating.

sequence.description: SAML allowedGroups misconfiguration: ensure '*' is treated as a literal group, not a wildcard; attacker with non-matching group should be rejected (authz gating).
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Effective permissions must be bounded by BrokerPolicy(config); allowedGroups must not behave like a wildcard matcher that permits unintended group memberships.

oracle_checks.violation_description: SAML login succeeded even though allowedGroups=['*'] should be treated as a literal group name; wildcard-like matching would violate BrokerPolicy(config) authorization gating.

finding.sequence_description: I5: After changing expected audience (entityIssuer), previously valid assertions for the old audience must not be accepted; tests re-auth after config change.
finding.description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_old_aud_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_old_aud_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: After changing entityIssuer (expected audience), Dex still accepted an assertion scoped to the old audience, violating authorization binding to current BrokerPolicy(config).

sequence.description: I5: After changing expected audience (entityIssuer), previously valid assertions for the old audience must not be accepted; tests re-auth after config change.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Effective session must be bound to the current BrokerPolicy(config) audience; after changing entityIssuer, assertions targeting the old audience must be rejected.

oracle_checks.violation_description: After changing entityIssuer (expected audience), Dex still accepted an assertion scoped to the old audience, violating authorization binding to current BrokerPolicy(config).
